text:
maya.k: heads-up: planning an admission/backpressure sweep Fri 2026-03-19 09:00 UTC. goal is to validate queueing, admission limits, and fallback routing for Dedicated GPU pools without impacting customer SLA. need ops owners and a short plan.

aj: what are the exact throughput targets and which model variants? tokens/sec or rps?

maya.k: plan outline: ramp 12m, hold 18m, cooldown 6m. two axes: tokens-per-sec sweep and rps sweep. models: rwd-v1-14B (fp16) primary, rwd-v1-7B-quant fallback. pools: dedicated-usw2-poolC, dedicated-euw2-poolD. stop if queue_length_total > 600 OR reject_rate > 1.5% OR est_cost > $220/hr.

aj: example loadgen command (sg-loadgen):
```bash
SG_LOADGEN=https://loadgen.internal:8443 \
  sg-loadgen \
    --run-id adm-sweep-20260319-02 \
    --model rwd-v1-14B \
    --mode token-rate \
    --tokens-per-sec 160000 \
    --seq-length 1024 \
    --concurrency 500 \
    --duration 36m \
    --tags env=staging,sweep=admtest
```
We can also flip to --rps mode for request-level tests.

liam: note: euw2 has maintenance Fri 03:00-05:00 UTC; avoid overlap. poolD currently has ~10% spare capacity. if we push too hard we might see node-level gpu_mem_pressure.

sophie: admission runs on tokens-per-sec at the pool level by default. we'll test 'tokens' mode first. config sample to apply:
```json
{ 'policy': 'tokens_per_sec', 'burst': 2.5, 'soft_threshold': 0.78, 'hard_threshold': 0.96, 'queue_limit': 350 }
```
apply via rbacctl to the pool.

maya.k: metrics to capture (promql): queue sum by pool, admitted_tokens/sec, increase(throttled_tokens[5m]), p95_inference_latency, node_gpu_util and gpu_mem_pressure. ensure agents on all nodes are healthy.

infra-bot: scheduling run id=adm-sweep-20260319-02 by maya.k at 2026-03-19T09:00:00Z -> workers=140, target={usw2:160k tps, euw2:100k tps}

aj: ramp started. initial sampling with seq=1024 looks fine. queue_usw2 trending up to ~210 at 09:11.

liam: seeing gpu_mem_pressure alerts on node-euw2-3 at 09:14, moving pods off. if it stays > 65% for 3m we should evict.

sophie: admission soft threshold showing increased throttled_tokens in usw2. enabling routing fallback to quantized: routing.fallback.enabled=true and fallback.model=rwd-v1-7B-quant. Also set circuit-breaker to limit cross-pool failover to 25% of capacity.

infra-bot: checkpoint 09:12 -> hold entered. peak admitted_tokens/sec observed=215k, total_queue_peak=480, fallback_fraction=18%

aj: admitted p95 latency stable at 1.1s; fallback p95 at 1.5-1.7s. 429s at ~0.6% currently.

maya.k: fallback volume higher than target. can we confirm egress/cost impact if more cross-region fallback happens? We should cap fallback by region.

sophie: set routing.fallback.region_pref=local_only for this run to avoid cross-region egress.

liam: evicted node-euw2-3 at 09:18 after sustained gpu_mem_pressure; queue_euw2 dropped from 220 -> 95 in 4m.

infra-bot: checkpoint 09:30 -> hold complete. summary: peak_tokens=222k, peak_queue=480, total_rejects=0.58%, fallback_pct=16.9%, est_cost=$175

aj: notes: admitted p95 ~1.08s, fallback p95 ~1.62s, rejects under 1% so within safety. we saw a small cluster of 5xx errors when a routing config rolled during the peak, probably due to config propagation delays.

sophie: will add a small stagger for config rollout next time and add health-check gating for routing. also bump soft_threshold to 0.80 in staging before next full sweep.

liam: add automation: if node gpu_mem_pressure > 60% for > 3m, trigger drain + warm-spare allocation. i'll open infra ticket.

maya.k: action items: 1) sophie: stage soft_threshold 0.80 and routing rollout gate. 2) liam: node-eviction automation + runbook. 3) aj: add a token-shaped smoke test in CI that mimics this profile. i'll file tickets and assign.

aj: will open PR with load profiles and CI harness.

sophie: will push the admission config change to staging and run a canary.

liam: will draft the node eviction automation and a rollback checklist.

maya.k: thanks team :rocket: good sweep. next time we include an egress-cost guard and simulate cross-region fallback under constrained bandwidth.

participants ack: aj: ack, sophie: ack, liam: ack, infra-bot: run complete
